people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Chebar
people.line: River in Babylonia; location of Ezekiel's visions

people.name: Ezekiel
people.line: Prophet during Babylonian exile; author of the Book of Ezekiel.

translations.web: Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.
translations.bsb: the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.
translations.kjv: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD
translations.asv: the word of Jehovah came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of Jehovah was there upon him.
